points.zh:
日本「俳聖」松尾芭蕉的經典俳句《 古池 》:

points.en:
Basho Matsuo's classic haiku "Koike":
By the quiet ancient pond
Frog bounces in
A plopping sound

en: In the early summer of the flower shadow mother-in-law

Colorful, drifting one by one, leaving only

zh: 有時， 海角是一抹月光
en: Sometimes the cape is a glimmer of moonlight.

zh: 但見網路密織，iPhone  飄浮
不知雲端深處，今夕是何時 ?
en: But I see the web is dense, the iPhone is floating
Deep in the clouds, what time is it tonight?

points.zh:
史蒂芬 · 賈伯斯 ( Steve  Jobs, 1955年2月24日－2011年10月5日）是蘋果公司的董事長。在他生活的年代，賈伯斯是電腦業界與娛樂業界的標誌性人物，也是Macintosh Computer、iPod、iPhone、iPad等知名數碼產品的締造者。他曾七次登上《時代雜誌》的封面，被認為是当时全球最成功的策略創業者之一。2007年，賈伯斯被《財富》雜誌評為年度最强有力產品經營者。賈伯斯的生涯造就了硅谷風險創業的傳奇，他將美學至上的設計理念推廣於全世界。他對簡約及便利設計的推崇，為他贏得了美譽和無數追隨者。下面三則取自他的名言:
1.  保持進取的意念.....堅持執著的傻勁。（Stay hungry .....  Stay foolish。這是賈伯斯最著名的語錄之一，於2005年在史丹福演講時，將這句曾在雜誌上看到的話分享給所有的學生。對這句話有各種不同的解讀，而有各式的翻譯。）
2.   你的時間有限，不要把時間虛耗在別人的生命中，不要陷入別人信奉的教條中，那不過是他人思考過的結果罷了，別讓自己內心的聲音被其他人的囉唆蓋掉。最重要的是，鼓起勇氣，跟隨你的心靈與直覺，追逐你心中想成為的人。
3.  我們必須讓小事也令人難忘。We’ve got to make the small things unforgettable.
points.en:
Steve Jobs (February 24, 1955 - October 5, 2011) was the chairman of Apple. During his lifetime, Jobs was an icon in the computer and entertainment industries, and the creator of well-known digital products such as the Macintosh Computer, iPod, iPhone, and iPad. He appeared on the cover of Time magazine seven times and was considered one of the most successful strategic entrepreneurs in the world at the time. In 2007, Jobs was named Fortune Magazine's Most Powerful Product Operator of the Year. Jobs's career has created the legend of Silicon Valley venture entrepreneurship, and he has promoted aesthetic-oriented design ideas all over the world. His admiration for simplicity and convenience in design has earned him a reputation and countless followers. Here are three quotes from him:
1. Maintain an enterprising mind..... the sillyness of persistence. (Stay hungry..... Stay foolish. This is one of Jobs' most famous quotes, which he shared with all of his students when he spoke at Stanford in 2005. There are various interpretations of this sentence, and there are various translations. ）
2. Your time is limited. Do not waste time in other people's lives. Do not fall into the dogma that others believe. That is just the result of other people's thinking. Do not let your inner voice be overshadowed by other people's. Most importantly, summon the courage to follow your heart and intuition and chase the person you want to be in your heart. 3. We must make small things memorable. We've got to make the small things unforgettable.
